sn45.169:1.3: sukhā vedanā. dukkhā vedanā. adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
sn45.169:1.5: imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave, tissannaṃ vedanānaṃ abhiññāya -pe- pariññāya -pe- parikkhayāya -pe- pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo. katamo ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti -pe- sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti. vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave, tissannaṃ vedanānaṃ abhiññāya -pe- pariññāya -pe- parikkhayāya -pe- pahānāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabboti.
